title: Switchcontrol 1.0.4 — Stability + Accuracy Update
headline: This update focuses on making Switchcontrol fully reliable. If something is enabled, it stays enabled. If it's applied, it shows correctly.
changes: Fixed CPU usage spikes caused by background process issues
Fixed Delivery Optimization conflicts — network tweaks now apply cleanly
Fixed tweaks resetting when switching tabs or reopening the app
Fixed UI showing incorrect (grey) state after restart — now reflects real system state
Improved tweak verification — checks actual Windows state instead of cached UI state
Improved PowerShell execution stability with global limiter and async loop control
Fixed trial expiry — premium tweaks now correctly revert when trial ends, including power plans
Improved app startup performance — reduced white flash and faster initial render
Fixed intermittent blank screen after login on Discord/auth edge cases
Improved overall stability — reduced race conditions across tweak execution, navigation, and background polling
